###GSE17538
setwd('F:\\NC_code\\Figure1A-B_S1a-d')
clinical = fread('GSE17538_clinical_data.csv',data.table = F,header = T)
inputdata = fread('GSE17538_ESTIATE_inputdata.csv',data.table = F,header = T)
clinical = subset(clinical,clinical$geo_accession %in% inputdata$Patient_ID)
inputdata = inputdata[match(clinical$geo_accession,inputdata$Patient_ID),]
identical(clinical$geo_accession,inputdata$Patient_ID)
inputdata$Gender = clinical$`gender:ch1`
table(inputdata$Group,inputdata$Gender)
chisq.test(inputdata$Group,inputdata$Gender)

###Qian_DataSet
###计算不同patient之间的性别差异中CAF的比例
EachSampleClusterDisA$Sex = ifelse(EachSampleClusterDisA$PatientGroup == 'Patient4' |
                                     EachSampleClusterDisA$PatientGroup == 'Patient5' | 
                                     EachSampleClusterDisA$PatientGroup == 'Patient7' ,'male','female')
Fibroblast_Sex = filter(EachSampleClusterDisA,EachSampleClusterDisA$CellTypes == 'Fibroblast')
Fibroblast_Sex = filter(Fibroblast_Sex,Fibroblast_Sex$Tissue == 'C')
pdf('Qian_Sex_CAF_female_male.pdf',width = 3.5,height = 6.5)
ggplot(data = Fibroblast_Sex, aes(x = Sex, 
                                  #color=PatientGroup,
                                  y=Number,
                                  color = Sex)) + #log2(as.numeric(CopyNumber)))
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5,size = 0.4)+
  geom_dotplot(binaxis = 'y',stackdir = 'center',fill = 'white',color = 'black',dotsize = 0.5)+
  scale_x_discrete(limit=c('female','male'),labels=c('female','male'))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0.2,0))+
  scale_color_manual(values= c("#66C2A5","#FC8D62"),name="")+#p1,p2,p3,p4,p5严格配色
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("#66C2A5","#FC8D62"))+
  #geom_line(linetype = "dashed",na.rm = T)+
  ylab("Number of CAF")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(color = "black"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid=element_blank(),
        legend.title=element_blank(), 
        axis.text.y=element_text(color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color="black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size=10),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=8,colour = "black",angle=45,hjust=1,vjust=1))+
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("female","male")),label="p.format",method = "wilcox.test",paired =F )+
  #facet_wrap(~Tissue,nrow=1,scale="free")+
  NoLegend()
#stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_sdl',
#fun.args = list(mult = 1),
#geom = 'pointrange',
#color = '#E31A1C')
dev.off()

###男性和女性肿瘤微环境中CAF的亚群区别及NCL表达亚群区别
##Male
getwd()
setwd('F:\\NC返修20250429\\20250526_Sex性别问题')
dge = read_rds('Sex_Qian_dge.gz')
Male_dge = dge[[1]]
Male_Fibro = subset(Male_dge,idents = 'Fibroblast')
DimPlot(Male_Fibro)
Male_Fibro = Male_Fibro %>% NormalizeData() %>% 
  FindVariableFeatures() %>% ScaleData() %>% RunPCA() %>% 
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:20) %>% FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>% 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)
DimPlot(Male_Fibro)
DotPlot(Male_Fibro,
        c('AIFM2','ACTA2','CD36','INHBA','FOXS1','KRT18','LTBP1','TAGLN','CTHRC1',
          'FGF7','ADH1B','PDGFRA',
          'DCN','IGFBP6','MFAP5',
          'NCL'),#CAF
        cols = c('#B3B3B3','#E41A1C'),
        group.by = 'RNA_snn_res.0.1')+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0.5,vjust=0.5))
Idents(Male_Fibro) = Male_Fibro@meta.data$RNA_snn_res.0.1
Male_Fibro = RenameIdents(Male_Fibro,
                                 '0' = 'NF',
                                 '1' = 'CAF',
                                 '2' = 'CAF',
                                 '3' = 'CAF',
                                 '4' = 'NF')
pdf('F:Male_QianDataSet_Fibroblast_Dimplot.pdf',width = 5.5,height = 4)
DimPlot(Male_Fibro,
        cols = c(mycolor[20],mycolor[26]))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
dev.off()
DotPlot(Male_Fibro,'NCL')
pdf('F:Male_QianDataSet_9_Candidate_Genes_Dotplot.pdf',width = 10,height = 4)
DotPlot(Male_Fibro,Cancidata_Genes,
        cols = c('#B3B3B3','#E41A1C'))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())+
  labs(x='',y='')
dev.off()
Male_CAF_sub = subset(Male_Fibro,idents = 'CAF')
DimPlot(Male_CAF_sub)
Male_CAF_sub = Male_CAF_sub %>% NormalizeData() %>% 
  FindVariableFeatures() %>% ScaleData() %>% RunPCA() %>% 
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:20) %>% FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>% 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)
DimPlot(Male_CAF_sub)
DotPlot(Male_CAF_sub,'NCL')
Male_diff_Fibroblast <- FindAllMarkers(Male_CAF_sub, 
                                  min.pct = 0.25, 
                                  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                                  only.pos = T)
Male_top_markers <- Male_diff_Fibroblast |>
  group_by(cluster) |> 
  slice_max(n = 20, order_by = avg_log2FC)
DotPlot(Male_CAF_sub,c('INHBA','CCL13','ADGRF5','RERGL','PLA2G2A','NCL'))
